entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that may include the Additional information IE under specific conditions.

entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: An optional information element that can be included by the AMF when specific payload container types are used.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: Information element that specifies the type of payload container being used.

entities.name: Payload container type is LPP message container
entities.description: Condition where the Payload container type IE is set to LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP) message container.

entities.name: Payload container type is LCS message container
entities.description: Condition where the Payload container type IE is set to Location services (LCS) message container.

relations.description: AMF may include the Additional information IE when specific payload container conditions are met.
Inclusion of Additional information IE is guarded by the condition that Payload container type is LPP message container.
Inclusion of Additional information IE is guarded by the condition that Payload container type is LCS message container.
Condition refers to the Payload container type IE being set to LPP message container.
Condition refers to the Payload container type IE being set to LCS message container.
